changes.reason: One native poll per original animation frame, read-only completion count, explicit pause/resume hooks and standard-gamepad disconnection cancellation; physics/rendering preserved. Before constructing the selected world, wait for its optional local road textures to decode.
Nine independent native keys, original keyboard and Gamepad retained, inactive menu/action quarantine, no rewarded release on cancellation.
Neutral pending player controls, pending item/jump latches and charged drift without calling reward-producing release; existing earned state preserved.
Remove runtime Google Fonts links; original families bundled locally. Original UI layout and visuals preserved.
The TV entry supplies original item artwork and driver portraits baked from their 3D models. Other callers still generate them on demand.
Choose a supported RGBA16F sample count or an RGBA8 scene target. Keep course color grading and effects; omit HDR bloom when half-float color attachments are unavailable.
Dispose the optional sky reflection map only when created.
Use the original sky and direct lights on devices without half-float color render targets; skip the optional PMREM map.
Render planar water reflections using RGBA8 when half-float render targets are unavailable.
Populate the original per-course texture cache from offline albedo and normal maps using the original sampling settings.

entry: src/main.js supplies original Game/UI/menus/audio composition without upstream developer/autopilot hooks.
tvArt: src/menu-art/ contains nine 160px item icons and eight 256px driver portraits rendered with the pinned upstream src/items/icons.js renderItemIcons() and renderPortraits() defaults. Stored as lossless PNGs.
courseArt: The six PNGs in src/track-art contain the original generated road materials. docs/course-textures.json records each authored seed, image and decoded RGBA SHA-256.
